<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram id="9fgZOxndadD--f4Y2Y--" name="Page-3"> <mxGraphModel dx="2943" dy="1606" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "classDiagram
class LogicalOperatorType {
 <<enumeration>>
 AND
 OR
 XOR
 }
 
 class TimePeriodPreposition {
 <<enumeration>>
 DURING
 OUTSIDE
 }
 
 class TimeUnit {
 <<enumeration>>
 MILLISECOND
 SECOND
 MINUTE
 HOUR
 }
 
 class ModifierType {
 <<enumeration>>
 LOCATION
 DESTINATION
 SOURCE
 TRIGGER
 }

 class Asset {
 +str asset_type
 +str name
 +str asset_id
 }
 class Modifier {
 +ModifierType type
 +Asset value
 }
 class StateCondition {
 +Asset subject
 +str subject_state
 +list~Modifier~ modifiers
 }
 class Action {
 +str action_verb
 +Asset actor
 +Asset object
 +list~Modifier~ modifiers
 }
 class Repetition {
 +int occurences
 +int time_value
 +TimeUnit time_unit
 }
 class Timing {
 +TimePeriodPreposition preposition
 +str time_period
 }
 class Event {
 +str id
 +str name
 +Action action
 +list~StateCondition~ preconditions
 +LogicalOperatorType precondition_operator
 +list~StateCondition~ postconditions
 +LogicalOperatorType postcondition_operator
 +Repetition repetition
 +Timing timing
 }
 class Completion {
 +list~Event~ event_refs
 +LogicalOperatorType operator
 }
 class Tactic {
 +str id
 +str name
 }
 class TechniqueModel {
 +str id
 +str name
 +list~Tactic~ tactics
 +dict~str,Asset~ assets
 +list~Event~ events
 +Completion completion
 }
 class Handle {
 +str hexadecimal_number
 +Asset target
 }
 class Process {
 +bool signed
 +str command_line
 +Process parent_process
 }
 class File {
 +str path
 +bool signed
 }
 class Registry {
 +str path
 }
 class Endpoint {
 +str port
 +str protocol
 +str ip_address
 }
 class NetworkConnection {
 +Endpoint destination
 +Process source
 +str transport_protocol
 }
 class Driver {
 +bool signed
 }
 class Module {
 +str path
 +bool signed
 }
 class Device {
 +str device_type
 }
 class Volume {
 +str path
 }
 class Account {
 +str scope
 }
 class Session {
 +str access_level
 }
 class Message {
 +str data
 }
 class Directory {
 +str path
 }

 Asset <|-- Handle
 Asset <|-- Process
 Asset <|-- File
 Asset <|-- Registry
 Asset <|-- Endpoint
 Asset <|-- NetworkConnection
 Asset <|-- Driver
 Asset <|-- Module
 Asset <|-- Device
 Asset <|-- Volume
 Asset <|-- Account
 Asset <|-- Session
 Asset <|-- Message
 Asset <|-- Directory

 Modifier --> Asset : value
 Modifier --> ModifierType : type
 StateCondition --> Asset : subject
 StateCondition --> \"*\" Modifier : modifiers
 Action --> Asset : actor
 Action --> Asset : object
 Action --> \"*\" Modifier : modifiers
 Event --> Action : action
 Event --> \"*\" StateCondition : preconditions
 Event --> \"*\" StateCondition : postconditions
 Event --> Repetition : repetition
 Event --> Timing : timing
 Event --> LogicalOperatorType : pre/postcondition_operator
 Completion --> \"*\" Event : event_refs
 Completion --> LogicalOperatorType : operator
 TechniqueModel --> \"*\" Tactic : tactics
 TechniqueModel --> \"*\" Asset : assets
 TechniqueModel --> \"*\" Event : events
 TechniqueModel --> Completion : completion
 Handle --> Asset : target
 Process --> Process : parent_process
 NetworkConnection --> Endpoint : destination
 NetworkConnection --> Process : source
 Timing --> TimePeriodPreposition : preposition
 Repetition --> TimeUnit : time_unit
